data.exact_reserve_text: The result for the year included net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m (2021: reserve release of GBP 2.1m) which deteriorated the combined ratio by 5.5% (2021: benefit of 1.5%). This strengthening was driven by reserve increases in relation to the China flood losses in Henan and Typhoon Rai, both on our Treaty Property Reinsurance class of business, partly offset by reserve releases on our professional lines class following favourable loss experience.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the syndicate's published gross claims development table, older underwriting years (<=2020) show a net favourable development (gross release) of approximately GBP 14.2m ( -3.35% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 424.0m). However, the Managing Agent reports a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m (net of reinsurance), driven by adverse reserve movements relating to the China Henan floods and Typhoon Rai on Treaty Property Reinsurance, partially offset by releases on professional lines following favourable claims experience. The gross triangle-based release contrasts with the reported net strengthening, indicating material reinsurance movements or differing scope between gross and net measurements.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates) and excludes 2021 and 2022 underwriting years per instructions; this produced a gross release (~-GBP 14.2m). The Managing Agent explicitly reports a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m (net of reinsurance), which is directionally opposite - indicating significant reinsurance effects or scope differences between gross and net measures. No explicit gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line was provided. Triangle method used as primary gross source; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m has confidence 0.8.
